 1988, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED  01.12.2022 PASSED IN MVC NO.750/2018 ON THE FILE OF THE Oriental Insurance Company Ltd vs Khutubuddin S/O Ameensab Tavargere on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140385499/
1  PRINCIPAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MOTOR  ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, HUBBALLI, AWARDING  COMPENSATION OF Rs.30,000/- WITH INTEREST AT 9  PERCENT P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL ITS  DEPOSIT.
 -2-  MFA No.101513 of 2023  THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
The compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal is Rs.30,000/-.
Since the value of the appeal is less than Rs.1,00,000/-, the appeal is not maintainable.
Hence, the appeal is dismissed as not maintainable.

However, it is made clear that in case the insurer challenges the awards arising from the same accident where liability is more than Rs.1,00,000/-, this order shall not come in the way of the appellant-insurer in raising appropriate contentions.

Sd/-
